positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
* Tech lead for all networking pieces of an integrated WAN optimization and ESXi virtualization product.
* Developed technology to deliver packets in a specified order through a chain of VM’s using SDN with OVS.
* Received a patent for technology enabling Riverbed’s flagship product to work through firewalls.
* Modified the Linux TCP/IP stack to enable custom TCP headers.
* Built technology to WAN optimize connections from services running local on the box.
* Worked on a team which processed every packet entering/exiting Riverbed’s flagship product.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
* Designed a clock synchronization algorithm for the wireless mesh network product.  It’s the backbone of SkyPilot’s technology.
* Developed an Atheros 802.11 radio driver with radar detection.
* Built a learning bridge to forward packets throughout the mesh.
* Performed board bring up on PPC platforms running the VxWorks RTOS.  Debugged hardware and wrote drivers for a variety of subsystems including timer, mmu, cache, interrupt, uart, flash, pci, i2c, ethernet, fpga, and gpio.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
* Developed a switch fabric proof of concept based on the Intel IXP1200 which secured Alloptic $10,000,000 in seed funding.
* Developed a multithreaded, pre-emptive, real-time operating system for initial products.
* Wrote crash dump software for PPC860 and PPC8260 processors which was vital for stabilizing our products.
* Developed BSPs and did board bring up on PPC, ARM, and MIPS platforms running VxWorks and ThreadX RTOS.  Debugged hardware and implemented drivers for ethernet, UART, interrupts, timers, flash, ppp, i2c, hdlc, etc.
* Worked on a small development team (3 engineers) to implement all levels of software for fiber to the home (FTTH) optical networking units used in Alloptic’s ethernet passive optical network (EPON).

patents.title: Preventing Data Corruption With Transparent Network Connections
